name: a member carrying another season's date widens the year set and welds

source.test: a member carrying another season's date widens the year set and welds

why: A FOURTH way seasons weld, and it is not a merge rule at all: a source asserting the wrong date. tvmaze:556-s3 is a season-scoped id stamped with the SHOW's premiere, which is season 1's, so the season 3 cluster claims 2016 as one of its years. Once both clusters really do claim 2016 and an identical title, nothing downstream can tell them apart, and `expect` records that. tvmaze and tmdb both did exactly this and both are fixed AT THE SOURCE, which is where the next one has to be fixed too: no merge rule can recover from a row that lies about its own date.
